2026-02-06 15:54:39.205 INFO: [HYBRID:<process>] [<instrument>] Requesting history for the period: [2026-02-05T15:54:36.012Z, 2026-02-06T15:54:39.204Z]

root_cause: The market-data-provider legacy connector updates batch connection status asynchronously, so the aggregator reads the status before the connector reaches its expected completed state.
